name: himalayas-app__himalayas-mcp
description: Remote jobs: job search, salary data and application tracking, or post a job and hire candidates. 79 tools: remote job search, companies, salary data and remote work stats with no sign-in; job seeker tools (profile, application tracker, tailored resumes and cover letters, interview practice, messages) and employer tools (post and manage jobs, company profile, talent search, candidate messaging) after OAuth sign-in.
